  • (OTPR) = Overtime Paid @ 1.5

  • (SHGRV) = Shift - Graveyard (2.30)
  • (SHN08) = Shift - Night R08 (2.20)
  • (SHSWG) = Shift - Swing (1.35)
  • (SHG06) = Shift – Graveyard R06 (2.30)
  • (SHU06) = Shift – Sunday R06 Diff (1.30)
  • (SHS06) = Shift – Swing R06 Diff (1.30)
  • (SHG99) = Shift – Graveyard Cadet (.28)
  • (SHS99) = Shift – Swing Cadet Diff (.23)
  • (HG5) = Planned Holiday Pay @1.0
  • (HG6) = Planned Holiday Pay @1.5
  • (ASBES) = Asbestos HazMat Hndl Diff (3.00)
